title: Taxonic is the second route into the Valtimo ecosystem if Ritense is unavailable
content:
Taxonic delivers Valtimo GZAC, which places it in the same ecosystem as Ritense and on the same Camunda-based orchestration layer. Its distinct value in the lead set is redundancy: it is the second route into Valtimo if Ritense turns out to be unavailable or conflicted.

That is worth stating explicitly, because a thesis resting on one supplier's cooperation is fragile in a way that is easy to overlook while the relationship is going well. Valtimo and GZAC are the case-management route into Dutch municipal work, and having two firms who deliver that combination means the route survives losing either one.

Because Taxonic runs the same Valtimo and Camunda pairing, the orchestration argument developed for that cohort transfers without modification. What the record does not establish is size, open-source contribution history, or anything distinguishing its delivery from Ritense's beyond availability. Priority 2.
